holes.name: Hole 1
holes.obstacleNotes: Short, open sand-and-straw lane from a raised turf pad; big mossy live oaks flank the basket.

holes.name: Hole 1 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Short, open sand-and-straw lane from a raised turf pad; big mossy live oaks flank the basket.

holes.name: Hole 2
holes.obstacleNotes: Long downhill hole: tee beside a wooden fence, wide mown lawn that drops away, then a pine-lined chute to a basket low in the trees.

holes.name: Hole 2 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Long downhill hole: tee beside a wooden fence, wide mown lawn that drops away, then a pine-lined chute to a basket low in the trees.

holes.name: Hole 3
holes.obstacleNotes: Tight lane through mixed pine and live-oak woods on a sandy trail; the line bends right near the end.

holes.name: Hole 3 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Tight lane through mixed pine and live-oak woods on a sandy trail; the line bends right near the end.

holes.name: Hole 4
holes.obstacleNotes: Tee on a built-up pad; fence and open ground on the left, oaks and pines closing in on the right. Basket in pine duff.

holes.name: Hole 4 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Tee on a built-up pad; fence and open ground on the left, oaks and pines closing in on the right. Basket in pine duff.

holes.name: Hole 5
holes.obstacleNotes: Starts through tall pines and wiregrass, opens to a sandy clearing, then climbs to a basket on a raised sandy knoll.

holes.name: Hole 5 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Starts through tall pines and wiregrass, opens to a sandy clearing, then climbs to a basket on a raised sandy knoll.

holes.name: Hole 6
holes.obstacleNotes: Elevated wooden tee box above a sandy pit floor (a taped line crosses the sand); basket on a slight rise at the far side.

holes.name: Hole 7
holes.obstacleNotes: Open sandy tee; one big live oak crowds the right side of the line and shades the basket.

holes.name: Hole 7 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Open sandy tee; one big live oak crowds the right side of the line and shades the basket.

holes.name: Hole 8
holes.obstacleNotes: Gravel path from the tee; basket tucked under a bank with a wooden staircase on the left.

holes.name: Hole 8 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Gravel path from the tee; basket tucked under a bank with a wooden staircase on the left.

holes.name: Hole 9
holes.obstacleNotes: Downhill from a turf tee into a wooded gully; tall pines and wiregrass around a basket in the low ground.

holes.name: Hole 9 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Downhill from a turf tee into a wooded gully; tall pines and wiregrass around a basket in the low ground.

holes.name: Hole 10
holes.obstacleNotes: Straight trail corridor through pine and oak woods; wooded both sides.

holes.name: Hole 10 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Straight trail corridor through pine and oak woods; wooded both sides.

holes.name: Hole 11
holes.obstacleNotes: Two-bend par 4 through woods into an oak meadow; big mossy oaks beside the middle of the hole.

holes.name: Hole 11 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Two-bend par 4 through woods into an oak meadow; big mossy oaks beside the middle of the hole.

holes.name: Hole 12
holes.obstacleNotes: Long par 3 down a clearing lined with pines; basket in open grass.

holes.name: Hole 12 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Long par 3 down a clearing lined with pines; basket in open grass.

holes.name: Hole 13
holes.obstacleNotes: Basket at the foot of a limestone wall in an old quarry bowl; gravel floor, pines on the rim.

holes.name: Hole 13 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Basket at the foot of a limestone wall in an old quarry bowl; gravel floor, pines on the rim.

holes.name: Hole 14
holes.obstacleNotes: Long two-bend par 5 through woods (UDisc geometry only; not studied on video).

holes.name: Hole 14 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Long two-bend par 5 through woods (UDisc geometry only; not studied on video).

holes.name: Hole 15
holes.obstacleNotes: Longest hole: a straight par 5 over rolling open ground between tree lines; palmettos and wiregrass near the basket.

holes.name: Hole 15 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Longest hole: a straight par 5 over rolling open ground between tree lines; palmettos and wiregrass near the basket.

holes.name: Hole 16
holes.obstacleNotes: Par 4 that bends twice through woods (UDisc geometry only).

holes.name: Hole 16 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Par 4 that bends twice through woods (UDisc geometry only).

holes.name: Hole 17
holes.obstacleNotes: Bending par 4 ending on a lawn; stone steps and a low ledge by the basket.

holes.name: Hole 17 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Bending par 4 ending on a lawn; stone steps and a low ledge by the basket.

holes.name: Hole 18
holes.obstacleNotes: Finishing hole: raised wooden tee platform, open lawn with scattered big oaks, basket near the crowd area.

holes.name: Hole 18 (Red line)
holes.obstacleNotes: Finishing hole: raised wooden tee platform, open lawn with scattered big oaks, basket near the crowd area.

layouts.name: MPO Supreme Flight Open
layouts.description: Gold tees to Blue baskets, 18 holes, par 66 (par and tournament lengths from the Jomez DiscGolf broadcast of the 2026 Supreme Flight Open; holes 14, 16 and 18 from UDisc).

layouts.name: Red to Red
layouts.description: UDisc 'Red to Red' (par 61): Red tees to Red baskets.
